title: CA-vs-non-anchor restricted revision-differential sign conditioning on USDCAD (vintaged first-print revision gaps, CA-anchored obs-month join, PIT-gated max-v2 availability entry, daily 16:00-NY grid)

blindness_declaration.statement: Written with ZERO outcome exposure: no scored/PnL/smoke/novelty numbers for this cycle were read; no backtest executed. Only timing, availability, coverage and count evidence from the pinned ng3 P0 restricted revision census (sha256 0fc108631e6b4bb2111c3528b873e68505ab2b46247d5e39cba24a12ff35017f, re-measured at this checkout), the P0 pin re-verification gate and the family-failure inventory was consumed; the census magnitude blocks are descriptive-only by their own law and were not used to set, move or justify any threshold or direction decision.

mechanism.story: Statistics agencies revise their CPI vintages. Each RESTRICTED first-print revision event (ng3 census law: v1->v2 vintage gap on the same obs month, full realtime windows, no bulk re-referencing group) is a public correction of already-published inflation information. An FX pair prices RELATIVE inflation between its two currencies: when Canada revises and the non-anchor legs (GB/AU/NZ/US restricted streams) revise in the SAME obs month, the quote-relevant object is not Canada's revision alone but the DIFFERENCE - how much CA's inflation path just moved relative to the contemporaneous non-anchor bloc. Slow money - monthly dealing-cycle benchmark rebalancers, calendar-fixing corporate hedgers - does not re-derive relative-inflation positions off vintage diffs in real time; their delayed implementation lands at scheduled windows inside the horizon this lane can provably observe, after both v2 vintages are evidenced-available.
mechanism.forced_or_late_participant: Forced/late participants: (i) monthly dealing-cycle real-money accounts implement relative-inflation updates only after the month's revision evidence completes and only at scheduled windows - structurally late relative to the v2 availability sequence; (ii) THIS LANE ITSELF is a declared late participant: entry requires the evidenced vintaged availability of BOTH sides of the differential - CA's v2 AND every active non-anchor leg's v2 - and the pinned census shows v2 vintage days arriving weeks-to-months after the obs month (census samples: CA obs 2017-11 v1 2018-01-02 -> v2 2018-10-09; GB obs 2017-11 v2 2018-05-24; the max-v2 bound therefore routinely delays the decision day by months). The hypothesis is specifically that the differential-conditioned repricing SURVIVES the PIT-provable max-v2 availability lag plus the 5-grid-day holding horizon, after costs.
mechanism.why_differential_not_absolute: An absolute CA revision mixes two components: a COMMON component (global price-cycle drift, methodology waves, re-referencing conventions - the same family that produced the bulk artifacts the census law excludes) and an IDIOSYNCRATIC CA component. USDCAD can only reprice on the component of CA's revision NOT shared with the USD-side inflation path. The differential D = R_CA - mean(active legs) strips the common component BY CONSTRUCTION because the active legs' same-obs-month revisions proxy it. Mechanically distinct information: two months with IDENTICAL R_CA can carry opposite differentials (CA +0.1pp vs legs +0.3pp => D = -0.2pp; CA +0.1pp vs legs -0.1pp => D = +0.2pp). The absolute-revision form cannot distinguish these months; the differential form exists precisely to trade the distinction. That distinction is also the kill surface: CTL-V7NODIFF runs the absolute form on the identical clock, and if it reproduces this anchor, the differential carries nothing (V7-class re-clock kill).
mechanism.when_it_must_fail: It must fail (after-cost per-trade expectancy <= 0) if USDCAD's late windows after joint v2 availability carry no differential-signed drift. It must die by falsification if the SAME book fired on the ABSOLUTE CA revision sign without any leg revision (the mandatory CTL-V7NODIFF - V7 reaction-direction re-clocked onto the revision clock) reproduces the anchor; if a nominal-yield-level exposure reproduces it (V8 law; ng1-A4-P2 cluster #15 proved the DGS10-level shadow the most lethal control in this program); if a constant-direction calendar shadow reproduces it (Q-7); if a sign-permuted differential book reproduces it (order-preserving placebo); if the quote-leg-only differential parameterization out-earns the all-active-legs mean (neighbour, V8 R2 standard); or at D2 if pooled ancestry |rho| > 0.20 vs the full inventory including the V6/V7 reaction books and the FXNG1-A5-P1 release-order anchor (accepted in advance).

information_source_and_surprise_construc.information_source: REALIZED vintaged CPI revision gaps from the pinned ng3 restricted (first-print) revision census only - no announcement-calendar, no publication-order, no consensus/forecast data anywhere (this lane reads NO release-order state: that ancestor is dead, see ancestry_defense). Per economy X and obs month m: v1 = first vintage publishing m, v2 = immediately following vintage (strict monotonicity, fail-closed), R_X(m) = 100 * ( I_v2(m) / I_v1(m) - 1 ) in percentage points (ng2 section 4 frozen semantics, inherited via the census import).

differential_construction.stream: RESTRICTED stream only, both sides of every differential: first_print_in_realtime_era=True AND no bulk re-referencing group membership (>= 10 events sharing an identical (v1 day, v2 day, ratio-to-1e-6) signature excluded by census law)
differential_construction.join_law: CA-anchored obs-month join, verbatim from the census: an obs month m (quarter-first-month keys for AU/NZ, V9 law) counts iff CA carries a restricted event AND >= 1 other economy (GB/AU/NZ/US non-anchor legs) carries a restricted event in the same obs month; months with non-anchor overlap but NO CA event are disclosed (15 measured, incl. the 2023-12..2024-12 US-only run) and NEVER counted; they are unreachable by every arm of this proposal (fail-closed, no patch)
differential_construction.anchor_form: D(m) = R_CA(m) - mean_{L in A(m)}( R_L(m) ), where A(m) = the set of non-anchor economies with restricted events in obs month m (simple arithmetic mean over legs; every leg equally weighted; A(m) non-empty by the join law)

universe.direction_law: D(m) >= +0.02 pp => CA revised up relative to the non-anchor bloc => long CAD => SHORT USDCAD. D(m) <= -0.02 pp => the mirror (LONG USDCAD). |D(m)| < 0.02 pp => no position. Two-sided by construction: no static currency or dollar bias.

ancestry_defense.v7_reaction_direction_closed_SPECIFIC: FOREX-FREE-V7 closed the reaction-direction class 'on both sides of the economy boundary' (FXFV7-A4-P1 cross-economy release-sign spillover died mechanically AND by falsification-by-control cluster #12; FXFV7-A6-P2 cross-pair lead-lag died with its own-lag control OUT-earning it; FOREX-FREE-V6's own-economy reaction-direction died on robustness). DECLARED KILL CANDIDATE. This lane's signal is a DIFFERENTIAL-OF-REVISIONS - a genuinely new information source relative to that class: (i) the object is a v1->v2 vintage gap (a correction of already-published information), not the sign of a release at publication - an object that does not exist in any V6/V7 construction; (ii) the conditioning is RELATIVE (CA minus contemporaneous legs), a two-sided statistic that changes sign when the legs revise WITH CA - the absolute form literally cannot represent it; (iii) entry is strictly after the max-v2 PIT-provable availability of BOTH sides (weeks-to-months after the obs month) - V6/V7 entered at publication instants. The distinction is ALSO carried as a mandatory measurement: CTL-V7NODIFF runs the absolute-revision sign on the identical fired book (kill at >= 0.5x same-sign per-trade, accepted in advance), and D2 pooled |rho| <= 0.20 applies vs the full inventory including the V6 anchor book and both V7 books; over the bar => lane dies at D2.
ancestry_defense.fxng1_a5_p1_release_order_closed_SPECIFI: FOREX-NG1 A5-P1 (opening-follower release-order own-pair rollout) is measured-dead (anchor -9.806836/trade net tier 2.0, PF 0.827161; R1/R3/R4/R5 FAIL; notably R2 PASSED - it was NOT a V7 re-clock; 'release-order frontier measured-dead on this grid'). DECLARED KILL CANDIDATE. This proposal reads NO publication order, no announcement calendar, no first-release instants and no release sequence state anywhere: its state is the census obs-month JOIN of restricted revision events, its values are v1->v2 gaps, and its clock is v2 vintaged availability. The axes are disjoint (order-of-release vs differential-of-revision); nevertheless the D2 pooled |rho| <= 0.20 gate applies vs the FXNG1-A5-P1 anchor book, and the same-clock/same-instrument overlap (USDCAD, 16:00-NY grid, 5-day hold) makes that rho measurement genuinely binding rather than nominal - accepted in advance.
ancestry_defense.v8_nominal_level_law: V8 falsification-by-control #14 made a nominal-exposure control MANDATORY on every yield/inflation lane, and FOREX-NG1 A4-P2 (cluster #15) was killed by exactly this control (CTL-DGS10LEVEL +4.13/trade out-earned a -6.63/trade anchor) - the DGS10-level shadow is the most lethal control in the forex program. Carried as CTL-DGS10LEVEL on the identical clock; no nominal yield level enters the signal. If the control reproduces the anchor, the family is dead by law.
ancestry_defense.v9_ppp_vetoes: V9 A5-P1/P2 died as PPP/real-rate LEVEL-misalignment books (rho 0.3034/0.3119 vs the V8 anchor). This proposal carries no PPP, real-rate, or level-misalignment state anywhere: the differential is a CHANGE-gap between two revision ratios, not a level; conditioning is event-time join structure, two-sided, magnitude-gated. D2 rho gate vs the V9 veto books applies.
